figurative_meaning_en: A person of utmost subservience or loyalty
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার বসের দাসানুদাস হয়ে গেছে।
আমি কারও দাসানুদাস হতে রাজি নই।
example_sentences_in_english: He has become a complete lackey to his boss.
I refuse to be anyone's slave of a slave.
note: The idiom emphasizes extreme devotion, often used negatively to denote blind obedience.
